messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered — sudden spike in 502/504 errors from edge gateway (eu-west-1). Error rate jumped from ~0.4% to ~11.8% in the last 3 minutes. Severity: high. Symptoms: connection timeouts to upstream pool, 502 responses to user requests. Autoscale status: healthy. Notifying on-call.

maria (oncall): on it. thanks bot. i'm joining the postmortem room, linking logs now. initial check: 5xx is concentrated on a subset of ingress hosts or spread? any customer-facing alerts yet? :eyes:

jon (infra): looking at ELB and edge-proxy aggregates — spread across 6/20 edge nodes in eu-west, but CASCADE alarm shows increased backend latency from our backend pool (svc-gen) around 14:41:22 UTC. upstream connection resets seen. grabbing tcpdump now.

sam (sre): i'm seeing kat-topology reports: p95 backend RTT up from 45ms -> 850ms for a specific AZ. 502 ratio aligns with that timeline. marking impacted tenants: ~4% of requests (by volume) -> but error % spikes for some routes (streaming endpoints) up to 30%.

maria (oncall): emily, can you check if CS has any high-sev customer threads? need to know user impact for comms.

emily (cs): on it. i've got one ticket from AcmeCorp reporting failures since ~14:42. escalating to account team. will post updates here.

jon (infra): tcpdump snippet (filtered):
```
14:41:25.123 IP 10.20.1.5.443 > 10.30.2.8.52345: Flags [R], seq 0, win 0, length 0
14:41:25.124 IP 10.20.1.5.443 > 10.30.2.9.52346: Flags [RST]
```
Looks like upstream connections are being reset. Checking upstream host health checks now.

maria (oncall): runbook suggests: 1) flip traffic to fallback pool, 2) increase retry attempts at the gateway for idempotent routes, 3) temporarily disable streaming mux on impacted hosts. i'm going to trigger fallback as a quick mitigation.

jon (infra): agreed. initiating policy: route-override -> fallback-gen-pool for eu-west edge nodes 3-8. command:
```
rbctl route override set --region eu-west-1 --from edge-pool-a --to fallback-gen-pool --hosts 3-8 --reason "502 spike auto-mitigation"
```

infra-bot: Command accepted. Rolling override to hosts 3-8 (eu-west-1). Expected propagation ~30s.

sam (sre): enabling soft-retries on ingress for non-streaming /v1/generate routes (3 retries, linear backoff 200ms). Deploying rule now.

maria (oncall): disabling streaming mux on the affected nodes per runbook:
```
rbctl config set-edge --hosts 3-8 --flag disable_streaming_mux=true
```

maria (oncall): observed immediate drop in 502 rate on hosts 5-8 after the override/deconfig. cluster-wide error rate down to ~4.2% — still elevated but improving.

jon (infra): digging into backend pool: one of the backend shards (gen-azc-04) shows threadpool exhaustion (blocked threads in model worker). increments in OOM killers? nope, no OOMs. likely slow GC/long tail due to large prompts. i'm throttling connections from that shard to prevent cascading.

sam (sre): adding short-term circuit breaker on gen-azc-04: max-connections->20, per-host concurrency cap. also enabling health-check stricter threshold so it will be removed from rotation if latency > 500ms for 2 checks.

emily (cs): customers updated: AcmeCorp is aware; we've told them we are mitigating and will follow up in 30m. reminding support to flag any SLA-impacting customers.

maria (oncall): current mitigation summary: traffic routed to fallback pool for affected hosts, streaming mux disabled on nodes 3-8, retries added, circuit-breaker applied to slow backend shard. monitoring p95 & 5xx now. creating incident channel and running timeline. assigning postmortem: jon + sam.

sam (sre): next steps: 1) let mitigations run for 10-15min, watch error rate and tail latencies; 2) if stable, gradually re-enable streaming mux and remove route-override; 3) run targeted evals against gen-azc-04 to reproduce slow-processing prompts. also will add temporary prompt-length cap rule for streaming endpoints.

jon (infra): logs to capture for postmortem (saving to /incidents/1742134567/logs.tar): edge proxy logs, upstream worker stacks, tcpdumps, route-override audit, health-check traces.

maria (oncall): good. marking the incident as "mitigating". i'll keep this thread updated. if anything regresses, please ping with @maria (oncall) and escalate to pager rotation.

incident-bot: Incident state changed: triggered -> mitigating. Pager active: maria (oncall). :white_check_mark:

maria (oncall): quick note — observed one noisy tenant with extremely long prompts causing backend blocking; sam, can you add a temporary upstream rate-limit for extremely long requests? we can relax after postmortem.

sam (sre): added request-size cap 1MB for streaming endpoints in eu-west fallback pool. will monitor for false positives.

maria (oncall): thanks all. next update in 10m unless status changes.
